title: CouponsStatusRequest
description: coupons.status-request@1: the body of POST /api/v1/coupons/:id/status on OpenVibe.Coupons (coupons.status.update; staff or a service): disabled, expired (not while disabled) or active (re-enable: the status is recomputed from reports and time); reported_working and reported_failed cannot be set by anyone.
